cards.text: Moses, Israel's leader, is up on Mount Sinai with the LORD (Exodus 24:16-18). The LORD has been laying out BIG plans for the tabernacle: the ark, the altars, the oil, the incense (Exodus 25-30). Now He tells Moses He's picked someone to lead the work.

cards.question: Who has the LORD called by name to lead the building of the tabernacle?

cards.text: Bezalel is the son of Uri, the son of Hur, from the tribe of Judah. And God doesn't just pick this man and wish him luck.

cards.question: God fills Bezalel with skill, ability and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship. He also fills him with the ___ of God.

cards.text: Bezalel can design artistic works in gold, silver AND bronze, so friend, this man is a whole workshop. I've worked with one material my entire life, it's dough, and some days the dough STILL wins.

cards.question: Gold, silver and bronze are just the start. God's plan is for Bezalel to be a master of every craft.

cards.text: And Bezalel isn't working alone, either. I've got a planet full of cookie boxes and ONE mustache, so I'm a little jealous of what God gives him next.

cards.question: Who does God select to be Bezalel's assistant?
Bezalel is from the tribe of Judah, and his assistant Oholiab is from the tribe of ___.

cards.text: God has also given skill to all the craftsmen, so they can make everything for the Tent of Meeting: the furniture, the priests' holy garments, even the oil and incense. Every piece is to be made according to all God has commanded Moses.

Then the LORD gives Moses a message for the Israelites, and this one isn't about gold or wood, it's about a day OFF. Friend, in that junk drawer every day was a day off, and let me tell you, it was NOT relaxing.

cards.question: The LORD's message for the Israelites is that they must surely keep His Sabbaths.

cards.text: God calls the Sabbath a sign between Him and the Israelites, and He says, 'Keep the Sabbath, for it is holy to you.' And friend, He does not treat this one lightly.

cards.question: The LORD says the Sabbath will be a sign between Him and the Israelites for the generations to come. It's so they may know what?

answers.text: That He is the LORD who sanctifies them
That He is the LORD who feeds them
That He is the LORD who fights for them

cards.question: God says anyone who profanes the Sabbath must surely be put to death.
God says that for ___ days work may be done, but the ___ day is a Sabbath of complete rest, holy to the LORD.

cards.text: The Israelites must keep the Sabbath as a permanent covenant for the generations to come, and friend, permanent means there's NO cancel-anytime button on this one. Then God says why it's a sign forever.

cards.question: Why is the Sabbath a sign between God and the Israelites forever?

answers.text: The LORD made the heavens and the earth in six days and rested on the seventh
The LORD led Israel out of Egypt in six days and rested on the seventh
The LORD gave all of His laws in six days and rested on the seventh

cards.text: When the LORD has finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai, He gives Moses something. Friend, the last time heaven gave ME something, I went from the back of a junk drawer to my own PLANET.

cards.question: What does the LORD give Moses on Mount Sinai?

answers.text: Two stone tablets written by God's finger
A scroll of the law written by Moses' hand
A gold plate engraved by Bezalel's hands
